38B Bra Size Guide: Measurements, Sister Sizes & Best Bras

Everything you need to know about the 38B bra size — from how it looks to the most comfortable bra styles for your shape.

38B at a Glance

Moderate projection on a fuller band. Comfort is key. This is a full-figure size. Understanding your 38B measurements helps you choose bras that fit comfortably and flatter your figure.

Measurements

Underbust 38" (97 cm)
Bust 40" (102 cm)
Category full-figure

Sister Sizes

40A Looser band, same cup volume
36C Snugger band, same cup volume

What Does a 38B Look Like?

[Image Placeholder: Person wearing a well-fitted 38B bra, shown from front and side angles with a neutral, relaxed posture.]

The bust appears balanced on the larger frame, with subtle, comfortable projection.

To help visualize: Think of two medium apples on a broader chest — soft, comfortable, and naturally proportioned.

On a 38-inch underbust, the bust projects approximately 2 inches from the chest wall. Breast shape — round, teardrop, slender, or tubular — can dramatically change how 38B looks on different bodies. Use our Breast Shape Calculator to identify your specific shape and learn how it affects fit.

Best Bra Styles for 38B

Based on the 38B profile, here are the bra styles we recommend for comfort, support, and a flattering silhouette:

T-Shirt Bra

Seamless, invisible under fitted tops.

Plunge Bra

Creates natural cleavage for lower necklines.

Wireless Bra

Comfortable all-day wear with sufficient support.

Tips for Wearing 38B

  • Get professionally fitted at least once a year — weight changes, pregnancy, and aging affect bra size.
  • If you are between sizes, choose the option that feels most comfortable on the loosest hook.
  • Replace bras every 6–12 months depending on wear — stretched bands reduce support.
  • Always fasten new bras on the loosest hook to extend their usable life as the elastic wears.
  • Mix up bra styles — wearing the same style daily can create pressure points.
  • For 38B, the band provides approximately 70% of the support — ensure it sits level all around, never riding up.

Frequently Asked Questions

What does a 38B look like?
The bust appears balanced on the larger frame, with subtle, comfortable projection. To visualize, Think of two medium apples on a broader chest — soft, comfortable, and naturally proportioned. Breast shape — round, teardrop, slender, or tubular — can make the same 38B look very different from person to person. Use our Breast Shape Calculator to identify your specific shape.
What are the sister sizes of 38B?
The sister sizes of 38B are 40A and 36C. 40A — if the band feels too tight on 38B, try this sister size: go up one band size and down one cup size for the same cup volume with a looser band. 36C — if the band feels too loose on 38B, try this sister size: go down one band size and up one cup size for the same cup volume with a snugger band. Sister sizes share the same cup volume but with different band lengths, making them useful when a bra feels close-but-not-perfect.
What type of bra is best for 38B?
The best bra types for 38B are: T-Shirt Bra — Seamless, invisible under fitted tops.; Plunge Bra — Creates natural cleavage for lower necklines.; Wireless Bra — Comfortable all-day wear with sufficient support.. The ideal style also depends on your breast shape and the outfits you wear. If you have a teardrop shape or concerns about support, prioritize fuller-coverage styles. For everyday versatility with 38B, start with a well-fitted T-shirt bra and build your collection from there.
